title: Ekanto Apon
desc: Sudipa falls in love with Ranobir, a goon, and soon, they both get married. However, things take a turn when Ranobir is arrested and gets imprisoned.

title: Praner Swami
desc: A businessman unsuccessfully looks for a prospective bride for his grandson, Moti. Later, Moti marries a woman, Moyna, of his choice, but she catches the eye of his friend, who wants her for himself.

title: Maya Mamata
desc: Mamata is the daughter of a wealthy industrialist who is married to Anil. However, when her mother-in-law drives her away, she strives to find love again.

title: Mem Saheb
desc: Kajal falls in love with Amit, an unemployed journalist. She urges him to focus on his career and provides unconditional support, but destiny has other plans for the couple.

title: Cheetah
desc: Jamal, a gangster, kills Amar's family. To everyone's surprise, the latter survives, wakes from a coma and seeks revenge.
